ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by dominant low-intensity pixels at the base with high-frequency mottling at the margins. Right lobe contains a large, contiguous high-intensity geometric blob occupying the distal quadrant, intersected by low-intensity linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a visible angle of approximately 45 degrees; the base vertex is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the full boundary of both lobes, featuring peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature sweeping upward and outward from the medial notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel nodes (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the high-intensity patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of ectoparasitic nodes (barnacles) on the lobe tips and distinct rake mark scarring on the right lobe's ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right lobes.
